thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8741 fired — synthetic check 'synth-canary-eu-5m' failing (5 failures in 2m). Probe: `canary-eu-5m` - target: /health/canary - symptom: 502 responses from eu-west cluster. Severity: critical. POD: eu1-canary-proxy. https://pagerduty.example/PD-8741

pagerduty: New incident created: PD-8741 — paging SRE-oncall rotation. Escalation level 1.

josh (oncall): ACK PD-8741 — I'm taking initial triage. Investigating 502s from eu-west. Pulling probe logs now.

josh (oncall): quick snapshot: 502 spike started ~1851234400, coincides with a small routing tweak from eng-runtime we deployed at ~1851234388. Will check routing table + canary-proxy logs.

incident-bot: Note: If not acknowledged in 2m, will escalate to sysadmin rotation. (ack received)

maria (sre): joining the thread. @josh can you share the last router config diff? I can take the handoff if you want.

josh (oncall): handing off to @maria in 2m — I grabbed logs and a short grep: `grep "502" /var/log/canary-proxy/*.log | tail -n 200` shows upstream connection resets to runtime-backend-03.

rahul (eng-runtime): I pushed a small routing change earlier to split traffic across runtime-backend-{01,02,03}. The change was intended to lower load on 03 but I may have miskeyed the healthcheck path. Rolling back now.

rahul (eng-runtime): rollback commands:
```bash
# revert the canary route change
kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/runtime-router ROUTE_CANARY=off --record
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deploy/runtime-router
```

olivia (support): noticing a couple of live customer reports referencing generation failures in EU: ticket #C-2321 and #C-2322. Both show 502s around 04:17Z. Will flag for CS & we may want a short update.

maria (sre): quick impact assessment: based on sampling, ~1.8% of synthetic probe traffic and ~0.4% of production API traffic in eu-west saw elevated 5xx rates. No widespread user data loss, but customers using EU-hosted endpoints may have experienced transient failures.

josh (oncall): mitigation action 1: paused canary probes to stop noisy alerts:
```bash
# pause synth canary
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $SYNTH_API_TOKEN" 
  https://synth-console.internal/api/probes/canary-eu-5m/pause
```
Action 2: created temporary routing rule to prefer runtime-backend-01/02 (bypass 03)

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8741 acknowledged by josh (oncall).

rahul (eng-runtime): rollback applied and restarted runtime-router pods. Logs show upstream health checks now green.

maria (sre): monitoring metrics: error rate in eu-west dropping from 4.2% -> 0.5% over last 3 minutes. Latency normalizing. I'll keep the canary paused until we validate a clean 15m window.

olivia (support): I'll post a short internal CS note: "We observed transient 502s in EU; mitigation applied and monitoring continuing. Recommending CS wait 30m before reaching out to affected customers unless they escalate."

josh (oncall): filing a timeline & assigning a postmortem: https://redwood-internal/pm/PD-8741 + assigning to rahul for root-cause analysis.

maria (sre): ETA to close the PD incident if no regressions: 30m. Will update every 10m or on change.

incident-bot: PD-8741 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. No further escalations.

rahul (eng-runtime): discovered root cause: healthcheck path for runtime-backend-03 was set to `/livez` but runtime was serving `/healthz`. Fix pushed to deploy config to align checks.

maria (sre): verification: re-enabled canary probe in dry-run mode, all probes pass 10/10. Prometheus alerts stable.

olivia (support): CS update posted to the incidents channel and draft customer note ready.

josh (oncall): closing PD-8741. Leaving monitoring for 30m, will reopen if we see recurrence.

maria (sre): resolved at 1851234672 — marking final note: routing misconfiguration (healthcheck mismatch) after small runtime routing tweak. Impact: transient 5xx for a small subset of EU requests and synth probes. Next steps: postmortem + runbook update to include healthcheck verification step when changing routes.

rahul (eng-runtime): adding remediation PR: https://git.example/r/infra/PR-987 — will add automated pre-deploy healthcheck validation.

josh (oncall): :white_check_mark: Thanks all. I'll add timeline to the incident board and close the thread once postmortem is scheduled.

maria (sre): tagging follow-ups: @rahul please own the fix PR; @olivia please queue customer comms if CS requests.
